{% autoescape off %}# PoliticalAgent

> PoliticalAgent is an English- and Polish-language AI research assistant for geopolitical questions. It searches a fixed list of {{ total_domains }} news publications and policy institutes, reads the pages it finds, and answers only from that text, linking every source. When search or reading fails, it returns an error instead of guessing. On explicit request it also makes a forecast: a council of seven AI models votes on dated claims drawn from twelve geopolitical forecasters' own writing, and the answer says how much of the research it rests on.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ SITE_ORIGIN }}/): how it works, the full source list, and its limits
- [Blog]({{ SITE_ORIGIN }}/blog/): AI-generated analysis of geopolitics, with every claim linked to a source
- [About]({{ SITE_ORIGIN }}/about/): who runs PoliticalAgent, contact, and the editorial policy
